adversarial_objective: rank sum of (ascending |delta MAE|) and (descending |delta SSIM|) over the unused candidate pool; ranks rather than a ratio because the two quantities are in incomparable units and any exchange rate between them would be an unregistered parameter
calibration_ladder_rule: equal-width bins over |delta MAE| from 0 to the largest available margin, one seeded draw per bin, empty bins filled by the nearest unused candidate to the bin centre; the dense charset gets its own ladder so the 'at least 4 on standard' clause is structural
